components_code_editor_ap: A CodeMirror widget helper used when creating and checking composition-related widgets in the editor view.
components_code_editor_au: A CodeMirror state helper that checks whether a facet or extension is active at a given position.
components_code_editor_balanced: A CodeMirror panel/gutter helper that balances and updates element heights within the editor layout.
components_code_editor_blocktiles: A CodeMirror DOM layout helper that computes block tile positions used when locating inline DOM near a document position.
components_code_editor_blur: A CodeMirror tooltip or autocomplete blur handler that closes related UI when the editor loses focus.
components_code_editor_builddeco: A CodeMirror decoration-builder helper that constructs a DecorationSet for rendering, working with a finish() step.
components_code_editor_bulletlist: A Lezer Markdown block parser rule for bullet (unordered) list nodes, used by CodeMirror's Markdown language support.
components_code_editor_createlistbox: A CodeMirror autocomplete helper that builds the DOM listbox used to display completion/option suggestions.
components_code_editor_cs: A CodeMirror view-measurement helper used alongside coordsAtPos() to measure text position on screen.
components_code_editor_cy: A PHP language-completion helper in Filament's code editor that adds completions and namespaces to autocomplete suggestions.
components_code_editor_decompose: A CodeMirror ChangeSet helper that decomposes a set of document changes into smaller mapped pieces.
components_code_editor_dl: A minified CodeMirror helper used in autocomplete/tooltip construction, working with facet() and sliceDoc().
components_code_editor_dt: A minified helper function in Filament's bundled code-editor.js.
components_code_editor_ed: A CodeMirror StateField helper used to define and dispatch a field's initial and update behavior.
components_code_editor_ef: A minified helper function in Filament's bundled code-editor.js.
components_code_editor_eg: A Lezer syntax tree traversal helper that walks nodes with cursor() and iterate().
components_code_editor_ensurehandlers: A CodeMirror ViewPlugin helper that registers DOM event handlers when the plugin's state is set up.
components_code_editor_ensureline: A CodeMirror line-decoration builder helper that ensures a line entry exists before adding block decorations.
components_code_editor_enterline: A CodeMirror heightmap/line-builder helper that enters a new line while building block content.
components_code_editor_er: A minified CodeMirror helper that manages the active plugin/extension stack.
components_code_editor_fc: A CodeMirror language-indentation helper that computes the base indentation for a given line.
components_code_editor_filter: A CodeMirror facet/extension helper that filters a set of values before they are applied to editor state.
components_code_editor_findindex: A CodeMirror autocomplete helper that finds the index of a matching completion option.
components_code_editor_finishinner: A Lezer incremental parser helper that finalizes an inner parse chunk.
components_code_editor_forceall: A Lezer LR parser error-recovery helper that forces reduction of the entire parse stack.
components_code_editor_forrange: A CodeMirror gutter/marker helper that iterates markers over a given line range.
components_code_editor_forwardinner: A Lezer Markdown block-parser helper that skips whitespace/indentation forward while scanning a line.
components_code_editor_fp: A CodeMirror selection helper used to read the current DOM selection range.
components_code_editor_fromclass: CodeMirror's ViewPlugin.fromClass(), which wraps a plugin class definition into a reusable view plugin extension.
components_code_editor_fromdom: A CodeMirror viewport helper that maps a DOM element or height to its corresponding document line block.
components_code_editor_fromjson: CodeMirror's EditorState.fromJSON(), which restores an editor state from a previously serialized JSON object.
components_code_editor_g0: A minified CodeMirror editor-state helper working with facet(), field() and lineAt().
components_code_editor_ga: A CodeMirror gutter helper that manages and updates the gutter's spacer element width.
components_code_editor_getviewport: A CodeMirror DocView helper that computes the range of lines currently rendered in the visible viewport.
components_code_editor_gx: A CodeMirror syntax-highlighting helper that matches bracket or tag context for highlight-range computation.
components_code_editor_handleevent: A CodeMirror DOM event dispatcher that routes editor events (such as keydown) to the appropriate handlers.
components_code_editor_hasaction: A Lezer LR parser stack helper that checks whether an error-recovery action is available.
components_code_editor_heightmetrics: A CodeMirror heightmap helper that computes height metrics for lines and blocks in the editor.
components_code_editor_hn: A CodeMirror history/changes helper used when accumulating and applying document changes.
